messages:
jen: FYI partner (Acme) just told us a live SKU mapping change — our reservation 987654 was split into two smaller SKUs mid-pick. ETA moved +14d. @matt @samir pls advise.

matt: ouch. which regions/orders? any customers on dedicated commits impacted?

jen: us-west & eu-west. affected dedicated reservations: 987654, 987655. committed capacity for two Q2 customers.

samir: can we accept partial ship and stage the rest at partner DC? that might keep customers happy while supplier fulfills remainder. @ana_acme?

ana_acme: (Acme) we can do partial ship from EU node but the smaller SKUs need different rack labels — partner ops put a hold to avoid mis-allocating. ETA for rest = +14 days. We can prioritize your committed orders if you sign a split-shipment addendum.

li: what's the manifest id? I need to open a marketplace change ticket.

jen: manifest 55-ACME-2026. Partner note: "batch-split-v2".

shipmentbot: manifest 55-ACME-2026 status -> HOLD (reason: SKU_SPLIT). Carrier ETA updated +336h.

matt: ok can we get a credit if they can't meet original ETA? we have SLA clauses for reserved capacity.

ana_acme: we can offer a one-time credit for shipping + expedited build if you choose consolidation at our EU hub. Otherwise we do partial ship and rest next shipment.

jen: action items:
- jen: request formal split-shipment addendum from Acme (I’ll draft)
- li: open marketplace change ticket with manifest + reservation IDs
- samir: propose temporary staging at partner DC and confirm costs

jen: reservation snippet I'm filing:```\nReservation IDs:\n- 987654\n- 987655\nManifest: 55-ACME-2026\nRequested action: split-ship or consolidation + credit\n```

li: filing ticket now -> https://marketplace.internal/tickets/MP-43210 (added manifest & partner note).

samir: estimated cost for partner DC staging: ~$4k for 14 days + handling. If we bill to partner via credit that covers it.

matt: sounds acceptable. jen, get addendum + timeline. If addendum not signed by EOD Friday, we trigger contingency: reassign customers to backup provider and invoice Acme for SLA breach.

jen: on it. cc @ana_acme will follow up with legal + ops. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
